name: Physlib Formalisation Report: Electromagnetic waves in homogeneous media, and Maxwell's equations in three dimensions
description: Physlib Contribution Report on work by Zhi Kai Pong: “Electromagnetic waves in homogeneous media, and Maxwell's equations in three dimensions”.

issuer.name: Physlib Contributions
issuer.description: An open-source community project to digitalize results from physics into Lean 4. Physlib Contributions publishes signed reports on reviewing, maintenance, refactoring, foundations, formalisation and documentation of Physlib.

credentialSubject.narrative: Formalised electromagnetic waves in homogeneous media: the wave equation from Maxwell's equations, plane and harmonic waves as solutions, and the transversality of E and B. Later stated Maxwell's equations in three dimensions on top of the electromagnetic potential, with the basic relations between the fields and the potential.

achievement.name: Physlib Formalisation Report
achievement.description: For adding to Physlib or PhyslibAlpha: new lemmas and definitions, and results from physics stated and proved on top of what is already there. This includes many small additions across different areas, as well as one larger result.

criteria.narrative:
- The work added new lemmas, definitions or results to Physlib or PhyslibAlpha, rather than restructuring existing code or setting up the basic definitions of an area.
- The work was merged and follows the library’s conventions.
- Links to the relevant pull requests are given as evidence.
